name: Jyoti Bhadrashetti
title: Project Manager
intro: I am a project manager at SRM Construction in Seattle. I lead teams on Altaire Queen Anne, a 114-home affordable housing project, and the 211-unit Astro Hotel conversion. My work includes budgets, procurement, subcontractor management and schedules.
Earlier I worked eight years in Mumbai and Dubai, first as an architect and then managing interior fit-outs for restaurants, clinics and retail.

I hold a master’s in construction management from the University of Washington and a Bachelor of Architecture from the University of Mumbai. I am a LEED AP BD+C, have completed OSHA 30-hour training and the DBIA core courses.
roles: Lead a team of six on Altaire Queen Anne, a 114-home affordable housing project, and a team of three on the 211-unit Astro Hotel conversion.
Lead GMP budgeting, trade bid packages, subcontractor procurement and contract formation.
Track committed costs, forecasts, billings and change orders; prepare project financial updates for owners and lenders.
Led construction management for Altaire at Jackson Park’s 207 affordable homes, delivering the project three months ahead of the contractual schedule and with substantial savings.
Managed RFIs and submittals across trades, coordinating responses with the architect, consultants, owner and site team.
Supported buyout, subcontract preparation and monthly cost reporting, keeping procurement and financial records current.
Coordinated documentation for the Evergreen Sustainable Development Standard (ESDS) process alongside permit renewals and safety inspections.
Relocated to the United States and completed a Master’s in Construction Management, March 2021–June 2022.
JBC Design-Build LLC / Joga Ram Group
Estimated construction and interior fit-out projects, translating client briefs into priced scopes and procurement plans.
Negotiated with vendors and subcontractors and procured finishes within project budgets.
Coordinated design changes with planning and commercial teams to account for cost and schedule effects.
Coordinated design, technical submissions and site delivery for hospitality, healthcare and retail interiors.
Managed contractor procurement, RFIs and progress meetings to resolve scope and delivery issues.
Coordinated specialist inspections and commissioning, including the four-month Parkers Restaurant fit-out.
Developed concepts, design development packages and issued-for-construction drawings for residential and commercial projects.
Coordinated structural and MEP design responses with the site team and resolved queries during site visits.
Prepared finish specifications and detailed drawings, including work on The Park in Worli.
qualifications: LEED AP Building Design + Construction (BD+C), Green Business Certification Inc. (GBCI)
BIM certified; first aid and CPR
Design-Build Institute of America (DBIA): core courses completed; CDCP and MRICS in progress

projects.name: Altaire at Queen Anne
projects.summary: Construction management for a 114-home affordable housing community in Lower Queen Anne.
projects.source: SRM Development project page and Jyoti’s 2026 résumé
projects.role: Project Manager, SRM Construction. I lead a team of six across cost control, procurement, subcontractor management and schedule.
projects.scope: The community includes studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom homes, with one level of below-grade parking. I coordinate procurement, project costs, subcontractors and the construction schedule.
projects.result: The project is under construction and will provide 114 affordable homes in Lower Queen Anne.

projects.result: The completed development provides 178 homes, with shared amenity spaces and rooftop decks.

projects.name: Parkers Restaurant
projects.summary: Execution of a restaurant interior fit-out at The Dubai Mall, completed in four months.
projects.role: Project Manager, Apple Fit Out Interiors. The project scope was execution of the interior fit-out, with design and technical coordination, procurement and site delivery.
projects.scope: Coordinated specialist finishes, imported lighting, the storefront and back-of-house kitchen. Procurement had to account for custom materials and the mall’s fire-rating requirements.
projects.result: The restaurant fit-out was completed in 2016 over a four-month program, bringing the dining areas, servery and kitchen into one operating space.
photos: The completed steel-and-glass storefront at The Dubai Mall, 2016.
Dining tables beside the glazed facade and planted wall, 2016.
The open servery and adjacent dining area after fit-out, 2016.
Back-of-house kitchen equipment and service area, 2016.

projects.name: Prime Medical Centre & Pharmacy
projects.summary: Design and build of a medical center and pharmacy within Reef Mall.
projects.role: Project Manager, Apple Fit Out Interiors. I coordinated design and technical submissions, procurement and delivery of the clinical and public spaces.
projects.scope: Fit the clinical program into the mall unit, including examination rooms, a lead-lined X-ray room, reception, waiting areas and a pharmacy. Material selection had to meet mall and Dubai Health Authority requirements within the project budget.
projects.result: The four-month project delivered the medical center and pharmacy interior in 2017. The gallery pairs design proposals with completed reception and waiting spaces.
photos: Reception desk and feature wall in the design proposal, 2017.
Completed waiting area and nurse station, 2017.
Completed reception with the waiting area alongside, 2017.
Design proposal for a consultation and examination room, 2017.

projects.name: Dubai Police Officers’ Club Lounge
projects.summary: Preconstruction and procurement for the design and build of an officers’ club interior.
projects.role: Pre-Construction Manager, JBC Design-Build / Joga Ram Group. My work covered estimating, design coordination, finish procurement and subcontractor selection.
projects.scope: Coordinated the design and procurement of timber slats, marble finishes, glass partitions and integrated lighting, including the transitions between walls and ceilings.
projects.result: The club interior was delivered over a two-month program in 2018. The gallery shows the design proposal, installation stage and completed lounge and meeting room.
photos: The completed lounge with timber fins and green marble, 2018.
Design proposal showing timber slats continuing into the ceiling, 2018.
Timber ceiling fins during installation, 2018.
The completed meeting room and integrated ceiling lighting, 2018.

projects.name: The Park
projects.firm: Kapadia Associates Design LLP, in collaboration with WOHA
projects.summary: Architectural design and coordination for a high-rise residential development in Worli.
projects.role: Project Architect, Kapadia Associates Design LLP. I contributed to design development, construction drawings, finish specifications and consultant coordination as part of the architecture team.
projects.scope: Developed the residential design with the project team and coordinated architectural information with structural and MEP consultants. The wider master plan combined residential towers and shared landscaped spaces.
projects.result: The design work established tower forms, planted terraces and resident open spaces. These images are architectural visualizations and plans from the design phase, rather than completion photographs.
